notes: Live research (Oct 2026): The official Erasmus+ page (https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/opportunities/individuals/students/erasmus-mundus-joint-masters, last updated 26 June 2025) confirms EMJM is the central Erasmus Mundus scheme run by the European Commission: 'Students apply directly to the institution running their chosen programme' and each master's website lists participating universities. The central scheme has no attached supervising professors; applicants choose among hundreds of individual EMJM programmes, each delivered by its own consortium. Not applicable per batch rules for central Erasmus Mundus schemes.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official ICCR A2A Scholarship Portal (https://a2ascholarships.iccr.gov.in) is a Government of India application portal ('Welcome to Indian Council for Cultural Relations Scholarship Portal', Content Owned by Indian Council for Cultural Relations, Government of India). The Suborno Jayanti scheme is a national government scholarship: applications are submitted through Indian Missions and forwarded to empanelled State/Central universities across India. No single institution or supervising professor is attached to the scheme, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official DAAD scholarship database (https://www.daad.de/en/study-and-research-in-germany/scholarships/scholarship-database/, rendered as 'Scholarship Database - DAAD') is a central database returning '149 Scholarship options' of DAAD funding programmes plus offers from other selected funding organisations. It is a search index, not an institution-attached programme; each listed programme is applied to separately. Not applicable per batch rules for central database schemes.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official Study in Korea portal (https://www.studyinkorea.go.kr, run by the National Institute for International Education (NIIED)) confirms GKS is a Republic of Korea government-invited scholarship: applicants apply via embassy or directly to one of 80+ GKS-participating universities of their choice. The central NIIED scheme has no attached supervising professor. Not applicable per batch rules.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official Study in Japan site (https://www.studyinjapan.go.jp, operated by JASSO with MEXT/MOFA) confirms MEXT is the Japanese Government (Monbukagakusho) national scholarship with embassy and university recommendation routes across Japanese institutions nationwide. The central scheme has no attached supervising professor. Not applicable per batch rules.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official Campus France India page (https://www.inde.campusfrance.org/france-excellence-charpak-scholarship-program) confirms France Excellence Charpak is the French government scholarship programme in India, administered by the French Embassy/Campus France India, divided into Bachelor/Master/Summer Training/Exchange sub-programmes. Awardees study at public and private institutions in France of their own choosing; no supervising professor or institution is attached to the central scheme. Not applicable.

Live research (Oct 2026): The official Campus France MOPGA 2027 page (https://www.campusfrance.org/en/mopga-2027, updated 15 September 2026) confirms MOPGA is a central French Government fellowship implemented by Campus France: applicants submit their own research project and must find their own host laboratory in France ('Finding a laboratory or research unit is an integral part of the application process'; 'Host laboratories do not receive any funding under the programme'). No specific professors or host labs are attached to the central programme itself. Not applicable per batch rules for central government schemes.
